measurements.particle_name: particles from UV-treated polypropylene mask, filtered through 0.45 μm
measurements.evidence_quote: The particles had a hydrodynamic diameter of 346.2 ± 10.14 nm (PDI 0.474 ± 0.052) and a zeta potential of -9.48 ± 0.193. || The UV-treated mask pieces (25 mg) were added to 5 ml of distilled water in a plastic tube (Eppendorf), vortexed for 1 min and an aliquot (10 μl) of the suspension was taken for microscopic analysis (DFM, AFM). || The size and zeta-potential of the filtered specimen was measured (Zetasizer Nano, Malvern, UK) and an aliquot of the filtrate (10 μl) was taken for microscopic (DFM, AFM) analysis.
measurements.evidence_location: Results, para 5; Methods, Mask treatment and specimen preparation
